entities.name: ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH
entities.description: UE state where attach procedures can be initiated under various conditions including timer expirations, PLMN changes, and upper layer requests.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE registration to the network.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE registration to both EPS and non-EPS services.

entities.name: Timer T3411
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers attach procedure initiation.

entities.name: Timer T3402
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers attach procedure initiation.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer that may prevent attach procedures except for emergency services or specific UE configurations.

entities.name: Timer T3447
entities.description: Timer that may be running but does not prevent attach for UEs configured with AC11-15.

entities.name: Emergency services condition
entities.description: Condition allowing attach procedure even when T3346 is running.

entities.name: UE configured with AC11-15 condition
entities.description: Condition allowing attach procedure even when T3402, T3346, or T3447 is running.

entities.name: PLMN change condition
entities.description: Condition triggering attach when entering new PLMN with specific constraints on forbidden lists.

entities.name: Tracking area change condition
entities.description: Condition triggering attach when tracking area changes with specific constraints on forbidden lists.

entities.name: Non-EPS services condition
entities.description: Condition where CM layer requests trigger combined attach or radio access technology selection.

entities.name: Exception data reporting condition
entities.description: Condition allowing attach for exceptional event data transmission when permitted by configuration.

entities.name: Emergency PDN connection condition
entities.description: Condition where upper layer request for emergency bearer services triggers attach.

entities.name: RLOS PDN connection condition
entities.description: Condition where upper layer request for RLOS PDN connection triggers attach if T3346 not running.
